datasheet: TI TPD2EUSB30 datasheet SLVSAC2G (rev. June 2021), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpd2eusb30.pdf, p26 DRT (R-PDSO-N3) outline 4206292-2/D, p27 DRT land pattern 4211172/A (both re-read 2026-10-11 in the LCSC C97502 copy of SLVSAC2G, PDF pages 20 and 21: body 1.0 x 0.8, lead span 0.95-1.05, lead width 0.10-0.20, TI land 0.30 x 0.30 pads at 0.85 x 0.70 centres; the current TI web revision of the datasheet no longer carries the DRT drawings), p3 Figure 5-1 pin configuration (1 D+, 2 D-, 3 GND)
derivation: IPC-7351 least density (L) variant of lib:TI_SOT-9X3-3_DRT (D109, D101 full land set): toe 0.56 (DRT lead span 0.95-1.05 -> tip 0.525 max + 0.035), heel and width 0.30 kept. Rule: outer land edge = max(terminal end nominal + 0.05, terminal end at max package tolerance + 0.03), capped at nominal + 0.15; heel kept unless it ran past D/2 - Lmax; side = max(IPC-7351B L X, b nominal), never wider than the original; courtyard = max(body, lands) + 0.10. Origin, pad numbers, EP/paste/mask and 3D model unchanged. Base derivation: rows centred on the package (pad 3 at y -0.425, pads 1/2 at +0.425); land 0.05 solder-mask clearance per p27 (KiCad default mask expansion)
